title: Local roles: ork approves every tool call
lead: *Proposed.* Owner decision 2026-11-12 (relay session 8d711f67, chat): a local role runs in manual permission mode and ork approves each tool call. The model-backed auto classifier does not work yet, so a local role never uses auto or plan mode. ork's approval point is full: it allows, denies with a reason the model reads, or asks the owner. A whole-file read over 500 lines is denied. Cloud roles keep their current allowlists and plan mode.
findings_note: S304 trial 2 (2026-11-12, S314): claude-local read whole files despite the brief's targeted-read paragraph (S343), reached 86k tokens, spent 50 of 90 min in three auto-compactions, and read its own transcript outside the worktree. The allowlist's `Read` entry has no path or size limit, and a call outside the allowlist is denied with nobody asked.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
*Proposed.* Today a claude-local role runs with `--allowedTools LIST --permission-prompts none` (`internal/agent/claude/args.go:47-61`), and the `claude-local` launcher adds `--permission-mode default`. ork approves only ahead of time, by the list. Trial 2's transcript (`~/.claude/projects/-home-jon-code-squalor-xyz-ork--worktrees-S314/06e09bef-cc2f-4722-b1a3-4866518a6e48.jsonl`) shows:

- `permissionMode: default` and no classifier call.
- One denial: "Permission for this tool use was denied. It requires approval, and this session has no approval surface".
- 32 `Read` calls, many without `limit`. These include `registry.go`, `settings.go` and `speccheck.go`, plus `Read` and `Bash` on its own transcript file outside the worktree.

A brief paragraph did not change what the model read; a refusal at the call does. The same point lets ork grant or ask for a call the list does not cover, which also covers what S346 asks for a local role.

claude CLI 2.1.322 offers two places for this (`claude --help`):

- `--permission-prompts host` with a permission prompt tool (an MCP tool that answers each prompt). It sees only calls the list does not already allow.
- A `PreToolUse` hook given with `--settings`. It sees every call, allowed or not, and can return allow, deny with a reason, or ask.

The read cap must also stop allowlisted `Read` calls, which the prompt tool never sees.

Open owner questions (Q1-Q3; the implementer asks them with `adj ask` before step 2):

- Q1 (`roles.local-approval-mechanism`): (a) *recommended*: a `PreToolUse` hook command served by the ork binary (`ork hook pretool`, reading the hook JSON on stdin), passed with `--settings`; it sees every call, needs no MCP server, and is stdlib JSON. (b) a permission prompt tool served by ork over MCP stdio, with the allowlist still doing the cap's work. (c) both: the hook for rules, the prompt tool for asking the owner.
- Q2 (`roles.local-approval-ask`): when a call matches no rule, how does ork ask the owner? (a) *recommended*: the hook blocks and the run shows a permission question (`ork answer` / the run pane), with a hook timeout set long enough for the owner to answer (deny on timeout). (b) deny at once and record the call for the owner to allow on retry (S346's per-run grant).
- Q3 (`roles.local-permission-mode`): does ork pass `--permission-mode manual` itself, or rely on the launcher's flag? (a) *recommended*: ork passes it for a local role, so the mode is ork's whether or not a launcher sets one, and the launcher's own flag is not needed.

Rules ork applies to a local role's call (*proposed*):

1. A path outside the slice worktree is denied (the reason names the worktree), except the main checkout's `.scratch/` folder, where AGENTS.md puts scratch files.
2. A `Read` with no `limit` of a file over 500 lines is denied: "this file has N lines; Grep first, then Read with offset and limit (at most 500 lines)". A `Read` with a `limit` over 500 is denied the same way.
3. A call the role's allowlist covers is allowed; the allowlist stays the source of what each role may run.
4. Anything else goes to the owner (Q2).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- A local role's args hold `--permission-mode manual` and the hook settings, and never `--permission-mode plan` or `auto`; a cloud role's args do not change.
- The hook denies a `Read` with no `limit` of a 501-line file, with the reason naming the line count and the 500 limit, and allows it on a 500-line file.
- The hook denies a `Read` with `limit` 600, and allows `offset` 1000 `limit` 200 on a 2000-line file.
- The hook denies a `Read` or `Bash` naming a path outside the worktree.
- The hook allows a call the role's allowlist covers, and sends any other call to the owner (Q2).
- A fake claude run where the hook denies a whole-file read records the denial on the run and goes on.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. `adj ask` Q1-Q3 with `--ref` this slice; wait for the owner's answers.
2. Build the approval point per Q1, test first.
3. Wire it into a local role's args (per Q3); keep cloud roles as they are.
4. Docs (*proposed*): `docs/design.md`, `docs/state.md`. CHANGELOG.md: one bullet under `## Unreleased`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go vet ./... && go test ./...` exits 0.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check --root /home/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork` and `adj lint` exit 0.
- `[AFTER LAND]` S304 trial 3 runs a claude-local implementer on a size S slice with the approval point live, and records the denials and the time in S304's notes.
